Maya (HW Ops): Heads up — FRA depot failed thermal preflight on 12 H100s from PO# PO-98234. Vendor proposing split RMA: 8 air-express replacements from EU pool, 4 sea/air later from APAC. Need customs HS code + quick decision on partial replace.

NexusSupply (Vendor): Confirmed. We're proposing:
```
AWB_air_express: 987-65432109
AWB_sea_later: 222-55500011
RMA_REF: NS-RMA-2026-1187
```
Air ship can go today if we get HS and warranty confirmation. Sea leg eta ~14 days. We'll absorb depot inspection fee if you accept split.

Liam (Sourcing): How much is "absorb"? need $ impact for finance. also: will the sea units be refurbished or new?

NexusSupply (Vendor): Air = new swap units. Sea = refurbished grade-A with full firmware flash + 90d warranty. We'll credit €6,000 per delayed unit to offset hold/ops. No depot inspection fee on our side. :+1:

Sam (Infra): Short-term ask: can we route traffic to Dedicated spare pool for the next 72h? If so, we reduce urgent air count to 4 instead of 8. That saves vendor cost and gives us runway.

Maya (HW Ops): Sam — we have 6 spare nodes in eu-dedicated-1 but warming them up takes ~6h and one config tweak for kernel patch. If we can flip tonight, reduce air to 6.

Anika (Logistics): I need final HS code to avoid customs hold. NexusSupply, please confirm HS and invoice values. Also need serial list for AWB labels.

NexusSupply (Vendor): HS code 8471.80.90 (computing equipment components) on all SKUs. Invoice values as listed on PO. Serial list attached in email — pinged you.

Liam (Sourcing): Accepting vendor credit contingent on proof of dispatch for air AWB today. Finance ok with €6k/unit credit if paperwork matches.

forwarder-bot: Tracking update 1772223345 — AWB 987-65432109: IN TRANSIT (FRA -> AMS) ETA 18h.

Maya (HW Ops): Plan then:
- Flip 4 nodes to Dedicated spare tonight (Sam + infra ops)
- Vendor to ship 6 air replacements (AWB above)
- Vendor to ship 4 sea/air later with refurb + €6k credit each
- Anika to confirm serials and HS on customs manifest
- Liam to confirm PO amendment for credit

Sam (Infra): I'll schedule the kernel flip window 22:00-23:00 CET and post deploy hook here. If warmup fails, we revert and escalate for full 8-air.

Anika (Logistics): Received serial CSV from NexusSupply. I'll upload manifests and request release for air. Please add this to the incident tracker: INC-2026-447 (impact = 6% reduction in H100 capacity for 12h).

Liam (Sourcing): I'll draft the PO amendment and tag @finance. Thanks everyone — please update this thread with final AWB proof and credit memo.

Maya (HW Ops): Thanks. tagging @oncall if the kernel warmup causes perf regression.

NexusSupply (Vendor): Will send proof of dispatch and credit memo within 2h. Good luck with the warmup.
